title: Augmentation-Guided Adversarial Training via Local Stability-Based Sample Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial training remains one of the most effective defenses against adversarial attacks, but its standard PGD-based training is computationally expensive because adversarial examples are generated for every training sample. Selective adversarial training reduces this cost by perturbing only a subset of samples. However, existing selective techniques typically rely on point-wise difficulty signals such as loss, entropy, margin, or gradients. We show that these point-wise criteria do not capture local instability in a sample's neighborhood. Motivated by this, we propose Augmentation-Guided Adversarial Training (AGAT), a selective adversarial training framework that uses augmentation-induced local variation to allocate samples with unstable neighborhoods for adversarial training. translated_title: 基于局部稳定性样本选择的增广引导对抗训练
translated_abstract: 对抗训练仍然是对抗攻击最有效的防御方法之一，但其标准的基于PGD的训练计算成本高昂，因为需要为每个训练样本都生成对抗样本。选择性对抗训练通过仅对部分样本进行扰动来降低这一成本。然而，现有的选择性技术通常依赖于逐点的难度信号，如损失、熵、边际或梯度。我们证明这些逐点准则无法捕捉样本邻域中的局部不稳定性。受此启发，我们提出了增广引导对抗训练（AGAT），这是一种选择性对抗训练框架，利用数据增广引起的局部变化，为邻域不稳定的样本分配对抗训练。AGAT使用基于增广的局部稳定性（ALS）对样本进行排序，这是一种轻量级评分，用于衡量模型在输入与其增广版本之间logits的归一化变化。
tldr: 提出了AGAT框架，利用轻量级的增广局部稳定性评分（ALS）识别邻域不稳定的样本进行选择性对抗训练，从而在降低计算成本的同时提升对抗鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes AGAT, a selective adversarial training framework that uses a lightweight Augmentation-based Local Stability (ALS) score to identify samples with unstable neighborhoods for adversarial training, reducing computational cost while maintaining robustness.
